name: skills
description: Claude Code plugins for adversarial code audits, GitHub PR workflows, OpenSpec planning, SRE, engineering management, on-device ML, security research, and asset generation.

plugins.name: agent-cost-report
plugins.description: Report Claude Code token spend for a project from local session transcripts: main vs subagent split, cache rewrites after idle gaps by cause, tool errors, hook denials, and top sessions.

plugins.name: agent-ready
plugins.description: Make any repo agent-ready. uplift audits a project read-only (CLIs, auth, MCP servers, env vars, permissions, CI, test/lint/build commands), reports gaps, then applies the CLAUDE.md, settings, hooks and docs changes (--report: read-only).

plugins.name: android-acceleration
plugins.description: Hardware-accelerated on-device AI inference for Android: ExecuTorch with XNNPACK, Qualcomm QNN, MediaTek NeuroPilot and Samsung Exynos, LiteRT and LiteRT-LM, ONNX Runtime Mobile, ML Kit GenAI (Gemini Nano), JNI bridges, fallback and profiling.

plugins.name: asset-gen
plugins.description: Generate images, sound effects, music, video, SVG icons, and 3D models through Google Gemini, ElevenLabs, and Meshy AI, with post-processing for padding, transparency, and vector tracing.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Adversarial code auditing with hunter/skeptic/referee agents, sized to the target: correctness bugs, performance, and security. audit:exhaustive checks every item in a named set one by one with a coverage proof.

plugins.name: coreml-optimization
plugins.description: Core ML and Apple Neural Engine optimization for iOS and macOS: coremltools conversion, ANE placement, split einsum attention, palettization and joint compression, stateful KV-cache models, MLComputePlan profiling, and Apple Foundation Models.

plugins.name: gh
plugins.description: GitHub CLI suite. Full PR workflow: open-pr, push, rebase, review, monitor-pr, worktree, plus raw `gh` commands for issues, checks, and GraphQL. Ships pr-watch.sh (block until CI or feedback needs you), and worktree.py (clone-seeded, prunable worktrees; a PreToolUse hook seeds Claude Code's own).

plugins.name: graphite
plugins.description: Stacked PR workflow through the Graphite CLI (gt) — create, submit, update, restack, sync, and merge stacks, and work review feedback across them.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Writing guide for clearer, more natural prose. Covers 33 readability habits — inflated language, filler, hedging, repetitive structure, passive voice, intensifiers, clichés — with before/after examples.

plugins.name: ios-debugging
plugins.description: iOS simulator control for Expo, React Native and Swift apps: boot, install, launch, deep-link navigation, accessibility-tree inspection, log streaming, location, push and status-bar overrides.

plugins.name: manager
plugins.description: Tools for engineering managers: 1:1 prep in every direction, team health snapshots, retros, annual rollups, new-hire onboarding plans, and your own self-review, built from git, GitHub PRs and issues.

plugins.name: model-quantization
plugins.description: Cross-platform model quantization and format conversion: AWQ, GPTQ, GGUF/llama.cpp, ONNX Runtime, ExecuTorch and LiteRT, plus mobile model selection, memory estimation, and quality validation.

plugins.name: openspec
plugins.description: OpenSpec spec-driven planning workflow (propose, explore, apply, update, sync, archive) as skills and /openspec: commands, plus /openspec:setup to adopt it in a repo and migrate existing plans. Wraps the OpenSpec CLI; needs `openspec` on PATH at the version in openspec-version.

plugins.name: refine
plugins.description: Improve quality of existing code and docs — full cleanup audits with parallel fixes, stale doc/comment sweeps, and quality reviews of changed code.

plugins.name: security-pentest
plugins.description: Authorized black-box penetration testing of live targets — hunters probe endpoints, skeptics re-test every finding, referees give the verdict. The live-target complement to audit:security's source review.

plugins.name: security-reverse
plugins.description: REA-first vulnerability research on compiled artifacts: decompile and trace native binaries, firmware, Android, .NET, Java, Electron, iOS, and WASM with the REA MCP server (manual Ghidra/jadx/ilspycmd toolchain as fallback), then audit the recovered code for exploitable bugs.

plugins.name: skill-improver
plugins.description: Review and fix Claude Code skills and plugins — frontmatter, routing descriptions, cost budgets, unreachable references, approval gates, and prompt anti-patterns.

plugins.name: sre
plugins.description: Site reliability engineering across PagerDuty, Sentry, and Splunk. Use for on-call, PIR/RCA authoring, querying logs and errors, or authoring runbooks.

plugins.name: startup-namer
plugins.description: Brainstorms startup, company, and product names and checks each one: domain availability over RDAP, WHOIS for purchasable domains, USPTO trademark conflicts by Nice class, SEO competition, and domain hacks.

plugins.name: status
plugins.description: Generate status updates from git history and PRs — daily standups and weekly management reports. Auto-detects repo and authors from git.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Ship work end to end. go-time: an approved plan or task list through parallel implementers, review, E2E matrix, PR, CI, auto-merge, and cleanup. bug-bash: mass-triage a GitHub Issues backlog, post replies, labels and closes, and swarm go-time fixers, one PR per bug. /broadcast: send a non-disruptive FYI to the other Claude sessions on this machine, grouped by repo.
